messages:
Jordan: Hey all — had an emergency dental crown last week. Spouse's employer plan paid part of it and the provider sent the remaining balance to me. I have the provider bill and the spouse EOB. How do I file a coordination-of-benefits (COB) claim with our plan to get reimbursed for the remainder? Any required forms or special fields I should include?

Alex (People Ops): Sorry about the hassle, Jordan. We handle this as a COB reimbursement. Steps: 1) Grab the COB form from the benefits portal (Benefits > Claims > Coordination of Benefits). 2) Complete member info (your Redwood member ID), spouse insurer name + policy/member ID, date of service, and provider info (name + NPI if available). 3) Attach spouse EOB (PDF) and the provider invoice showing patient responsibility. 4) Upload via portal or email benefits@redwood.com with subject: "COB claim - [Your Name] - [DOS]".

Jordan: Do I need the spouse insurer's claim number? The provider originally billed spouse's plan and put their name as subscriber. Could that slow us down?

Alex (People Ops): If the spouse EOB includes their claim/reference number, include it — it speeds verification. If the provider billed the wrong subscriber, add a short note and a screenshot of the invoice line showing who was billed; we'll coordinate with the carrier and, if needed, request an adjustment from the provider so the patient liability lines up.

Priya: Typical turnaround is 7-10 business days after we have complete docs. If we need coordination from spouse's carrier directly, we might ask you to authorize release of info (we'll send a simple form). If it's time-sensitive (bill due), mark the email subject with "EXPEDITE" and attach the invoice with due date.

BenefitsBot: Upload link: https://benefits.redwood.com/claims/upload — choose "Coordination of Benefits" and attach PDFs.

Jordan: Uploading now. I have spouse EOB (shows amount allowed/paid), provider invoice (shows remaining balance) and the provider NPI. Thanks for the quick help! :thumbsup:
